$schema: Accepted-risk register for the code-health analyzer.
description: Each entry documents a finding that has been reviewed and accepted as safe or intentional. Entries are matched by stable fingerprint (sha1 of ruleId::file::symbol::line, first 12 chars). Accepted findings are reported in a separate metric and never counted as open vulnerabilities. Keep entries narrow, justified, owned, and covered by a regression test where a safety property is relied upon.

acceptedRisks.reason: Single app-runtime child_process site (intentional-safe). Executable pinned to process.execPath; argv array only; shell:false; allowlisted flags; timeout + output caps; scrubbed child env; productId validated at callers; auth-guarded routes.
